_note: SSOT for the image-quality study: levels (camera classes), questions, clips + true answers + credits, where clips + answers live. make-clips.cjs, build.cjs, analyze.cjs read this. Clip id = opaque (shown to raters, in file names); name = human label (never shipped). source: open = committed open-license file tools/quality/open/<name>.mp4 → public build (out); private = tools/quality/sources/<name>.mp4 (gitignored) → --real build (privateOut, gitignored). crop = ffmpeg crop to the scope image (default: centered square).
